commands.command: npm run test:browser -- telegram-details.spec.ts conversation-pages.spec.ts messenger-management.spec.ts telegram-messenger.spec.ts

browserTests.title: conversation members and media follow server pagination and a media filter restarts its cursor
conversation settings retain failed selections and leave confirmation retains failure until accepted
education roles do not grant group ownership and system managed conversation does not expose manual management
direct conversation info is reached from chat and archive uses confirmed user state
conversation detail pages preserve RTL and layout at mobile tablet and desktop
groups: two-step creation persists information and invited contacts, then creates once
channels: two-step creation persists information and invited contacts, then creates once
unknown creation failure retries the identical operation after reload, without creating in the information step
owner edits information, adds a contact, changes administrator role and removes membership with confirmed server responses
school Teacher cannot mutate another conversation owner data, including through direct API requests
unified inbox includes direct and official conversations without a personal-school switch in three layouts
unified inbox exhausts scope pagination independently and retains earlier conversations
creation and member management remain usable in both themes across mobile tablet desktop
a definitive invitation-required rejection preserves the draft and reopens contacts without replaying the denied operation
loading more remains clickable during a background inbox refresh and the intent survives it
mute is confirmed by the service and a failed change never shows false success
invite link creation retries with one command, requires approval, then can be revoked
topic draft survives errors and status changes only after server confirmation
non owners never see invite management and the service rejects a direct mutation
reference group and channel surfaces keep RTL, focus and touch targets in both themes at three sizes
Telegram messenger light 390: usable list, chat and menus
Telegram messenger light 834: usable list, chat and menus
Telegram messenger light 1440: usable list, chat and menus
Telegram messenger dark 390: usable list, chat and menus
Telegram messenger dark 834: usable list, chat and menus
Telegram messenger dark 1440: usable list, chat and menus
chat survives live resizing and attachment failure retains both file and caption
message context menu replies to the selected message and returns focus to the composer
messenger directory, creation and settings pages remain usable above navigation in both themes
photo video and file reach the other fixture account and download with identical bytes

limits: Automated tests use the isolated local fixture, not the remote test backend.
No claim of server security or live mutation success from fixture tests.
Full unrelated educational suite was not repeated; messenger-related suites were run.
One earlier pagination failure is preserved in TELEGRAM_DETAILS_INITIAL_BROWSER.json; it was fixed and covered by a deterministic background-refresh test.
